_comment: Pass/fail thresholds for parity/results/metrics.json, checked by compare.py. A rule's path may use '*' for any key; a rule that matches no metric is a violation unless it is 'optional' (for datasets that may be skipped). 'why' explains each bound.

rules.why: arcsinh equals flowCore up to f32 output rounding
logicle equals flowCore on its 0..M output scale
FlowKit's Gating-ML logicle is the same curve on a 0..1 scale: compare up to an affine map
hyperlog equals flowCore and FlowKit
biexponential equals flowjo_biexp with the AutoSpill parameters (the 4096-channel reference uses different parameters on purpose)
spillover matrix equals autospill to round-off
reference spectra match the truth
unmixing equals upstream OLS on the same spectra
PeacoQC masks equal R PeacoQC in every mode
cytiq and CompensAID rate the same marker channels: the labelled ones the matrix compensates
deGate cut-offs are density grid points; density (1e-9) and smooth.spline match R, so the same grid point is chosen
cut-offs, segment edges, medians and SDs come from the same events as CompensAID's: margins, logicle and PeacoQC match R
CompensAID rounds the SSI to 2 decimals; a round-off difference can move a value across a rounding boundary by one step
the same pairs and segments are unassessed or merged as in CompensAID
segment and merged event counts equal CompensAID's
PASS / merged / no-population messages equal CompensAID's
every pair gets CompensAID's verdict (|SSI| >= 1)
both injected spillover errors (under PE->PerCP-Cy5.5, over APC->APC-Cy7) are flagged in their direction
the injected errors are shared by every tube, so the batch view calls both recurrent
separated populations: R reaches 0.9997 seed to seed
overlapping populations: R's own seed-to-seed minimum is 0.93; no bit-exact RNG
CytoScan features equal R on the full-sample dataset
isolation-forest outlier flags agree with R; subsampled cohorts differ by at most one file in twenty
regression floor: the novelty detector finds the injected anomalous files (lowest today: cytoscan_ref100 fingerprint, 4 of 5)
